description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to sharing Buzz posts within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends a base filter params class and includes a postId attribute with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering Buzz post shares based on post ID, extending the core FilterParams class.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the post ID used as a filter parameter.

methods.name: setPostId
methods.description: Sets the post ID used as a filter parameter.
